flowerbonemeal.config.title: Flower Bone Meal Duplication
flowerbonemeal.option.mod_enabled.toolti:
Yes: bone meal makes flowers drop a copy of themselves.
No: the mod is switched off and bone meal works exactly like vanilla.
flowerbonemeal.option.flowering_azalea.t:
Yes: bone meal on flowering azalea drops a copy.
No: vanilla behaviour (grows an azalea tree).
Also applies to modded flowers that grow into trees.
flowerbonemeal.option.mangrove_propagule:
Yes: bone meal on a mangrove propagule drops a copy.
No: vanilla behaviour (grows it a stage).
Also applies to modded flowers that grow in stages like it.
flowerbonemeal.option.pink_petals_wildfl:
Yes: bone meal on pink petals or wildflowers drops a copy.
No: vanilla behaviour (adds a petal or spreads).
Also applies to modded petal flowers like them.
flowerbonemeal.option.wither_rose.toolti:
Yes: bone meal on a wither rose drops a copy.
No: vanilla behaviour (bone meal does nothing to wither roses).
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.flowerbon: Using bone meal on any flower drops a copy of that flower.
